fusions.name: Swarm off the Spin
fusions.desc: You whirl the staff and fling 4 buzzing bolts in a wide spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 10 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gnawing Jab
fusions.desc: You jab a biting spray of insects from the staff's tip at the first enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 7 damage and healing you for 20% of it. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stirred From the Stubble
fusions.desc: You beat the stubble with the staff and stir up a swarm of locusts for 10 seconds. It bites enemies within 4 tiles of it for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Strips the Field
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
